pass_meta.note: 11 Nov 2026, run 557: link the filed group-paging ticket SV-12540 (Open) to C1062570/C1062571.

C1062570.failed_steps: Failed at steps 2 and 3: the open group does not show 100 invoices first and then load the rest as you scroll; all of them come at once.
C1062570.source: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter" (Confluence 947650561, version 11, 5 Nov 2026), S1-R8: "On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices, an open customer or vendor shows its first 100 documents, then the next 100 as the user scrolls; its document count, its subtotals, the Totals row and the exports always cover all of its documents."
observed: Set up: customer ZZAUTOTEST OVER100 C with 105 overdue invoices; A/R Aging Collection with only that customer ticked in Customer.
Step 2: opening the group brings all 105 invoices at once - the server sends every one of them in its first answer.
Step 3: scrolling past the 100th invoice (S11315-17714) loads nothing: invoices 101 to 105 are already there, with no loading row.
The test says the group shows its first 100 invoices and then loads the next ones under them, up to 100 more each time.
C1062570.todo: What needs to be done: nothing for the tester now; re-run this test once the ticket is filed and fixed.
